model: Redlich-Kister excess molar volume of binary liquid mixtures: V_E = x_a x_b sum_k A_k (x_a - x_b)^k, cm3 per mole of mixture
source: Redlich-Kister coefficients of the water + ethanol and water + acetone excess volumes at 25 C, recalled from textbook / DECHEMA-type compilations; verify against the pipeline's measured-density sets. A pair that is not listed here has no excess volume: the volumes add (ideal) and the phase is labelled so.
